expectation.answer: coding_context.prepare presents PKC012 as an observed API/persistence effect in a declared core/helper owner. Product-wide adopted guidance should remain applicable without establishing that every project contains those mechanisms. This expectation follows the installed observed-source blocker contract and pure compilation-owner role.

lesson.answer: Keep product guidance selection and project-level observed effects separate. Test pure/empty Core projects and real effects under the same adopted product capabilities so PKC012 stays meaningful.

observation.answer: Retained plan records a false PKC012 prerequisite blocker. A fresh source-level reproduction shows original feature_context.context inherits api and persistence tags for empty and pure-record Core source when the product adopts those capabilities. The coding_context.prepare source_tags call uses that inherited result in its PKC012 predicate. The local remedy removes only inherited adoption from observed-source classification; actual DbContext and MapGet mechanisms remain detected.

remedy.answer: Added optional inherit_adoption=True to feature_context.context and use False only for coding_context.prepare observed project source classification. Preserve default product guidance, real mechanism detection, native dependency/source checks and semantic review. Local remedy only; the fresh proof is source-level, not a full preflight run.
